uid.description: A unique identifier for the pulse item.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the pulse item was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the pulse item was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

status.description: The current lifecycle status of the pulse item. Only 'active' items are returned by the list endpoint; 'dismissed' and 'completed' are terminal.

category.description: The stored category of the pulse item. Note: the `category` query parameter and the `counts`/response-level `category` fields on the list endpoint also accept the virtual 'upcoming' category, which is never a stored value here.

priority.description: Relative ordering priority within a category. 1 = higher priority, 2 = lower priority.

tags.description: Optional tag(s) describing the item (e.g., 'Hot lead'). MVP limits this to a single tag.

due_at.description: Optional due/target time. When set and in the future, the item surfaces under the 'upcoming' category instead of its stored category.

expired_at.description: Optional expiry time for the pulse item.

display.description: Display-related information for the item, e.g. a title and the related client's name. Shape is producer-defined and may vary.

title.description: A human-readable title describing the pulse item.

client_name.description: The name of the client this pulse item relates to, when applicable.

reason.description: The reasoning behind the recommendation, typically produced by the LLM. May be absent while the item is still pending.

context.description: The context this pulse item is about.

context_uid.description: A unique identifier for the related context (e.g., a matter or client UID).

action.description: The primary recommended action for this item, executed via `POST /v3/ai/pulse_items/{uid}/execute`. Only the first recommended action is exposed here, even if more were generated internally.

payload.description: Action-specific data. Structure depends on `action` (e.g., `{ "message": "..." }` for 'reply').

example.reason: The client asked about availability and you have an open slot.

description: A curated, actionable feed item surfaced to staff — needing attention, upcoming, or FYI — backed by the underlying AIRecommendation record.
